dossiers.content: Meeting note, 12 May: The team approved a travel budget of $4,800 for the June workshop. The approval was unanimous.
dossiers.question: What was the approved travel budget?

dossiers.content: Interview schedule: Candidate interviews will take place in Room 214 on Thursday. Facilities confirmed the reservation.
dossiers.question: Which room is reserved for the interview?

dossiers.content: Project tracker: The database migration is assigned to Nia Patel. Target completion is 18 October.
dossiers.question: Who owns the migration task?

dossiers.content: Product specification: Maximum rated input voltage is 24 V DC. Use only the specified power adapter.
dossiers.question: What is the device's maximum rated input voltage?

dossiers.content: Contract summary: The 30-day trial began on 1 March and ends on 30 March, inclusive.
dossiers.question: When does the trial period end?

dossiers.content: Quarterly vendor packet — account overview: Northstar Office Supply has served the company since 2019. The account is managed by procurement. The packet contains delivery notes, a tax certificate, three email threads, and a payment schedule. The shipment included paper, toner, folders, and labels. Delivery was confirmed on 6 September. The invoice total is $1,284.60 before tax. Receiving noted two cartons arrived separately. In the footer of the second email thread, the invoice is identified as INV-7714 and its purchase-order number is PO-48319. The remittance address has not changed. Finance normally processes approved invoices within 14 days.
dossiers.question: What is the invoice's purchase-order number?

dossiers.content: Laboratory log: The instrument was calibrated at 08:00 and checked at noon. The operator wore nitrile gloves and room humidity was 41%. Sample A was clear; Sample B was amber. At 13:50 the reading was 19.1°C. A brief power interruption occurred at 14:05, after which the device restarted normally. The 14:20 entry, halfway down the second page, reads 21.6°C. The final reading at 15:00 was 20.8°C. No samples were discarded.
dossiers.question: What was the measured temperature at 14:20?

dossiers.content: Route planning notes: The primary destination is Tulsa, Oklahoma. Driver assignments changed twice due to a vehicle inspection. Fuel receipts list stops in Muskogee and Claremore. The shipment contains non-perishable supplies and requires a signature. In an older planning note quoted near the end, the backup destination is Wichita, Kansas. Dispatch reaffirmed that note in the latest revision. The expected arrival window is 10:00–12:00.
dossiers.question: Which city was listed as the backup delivery destination?

dossiers.content: Maintenance report: Unit 6 was inspected after a pressure drop. The technician cleaned the intake grill and replaced a worn gasket. Three possible filters were considered: FX-210, FX-210B, and FX-211. A purchasing note says the approved replacement is FX-210B, the model identifier printed on the carton label. The service visit lasted 46 minutes. No further pressure loss was observed during follow-up.
dossiers.question: What is the exact model identifier of the replacement filter?

dossiers.content: Editorial correspondence: The team discussed tone, section order, image permissions, and a new introduction. An early message proposed Friday, 4 PM, but the editor later asked whether Monday would be more realistic. The final decision appears in a reply nested under “Re: final assets”: “Agreed — revised draft due Tuesday, 22 September, by 11:00 AM local time.” The style guide remains unchanged. The designer will deliver the cover separately.
dossiers.question: What was the agreed deadline for the revised draft?

dossiers.content: Grade report summary: The course had 32 students. The exam was worth 100 points and the class average was 81.4. The median was 84, and the highest score was 99. Student ID 1842 was enrolled and completed the exam. All scores were checked by the instructor. The report is marked FINAL and approved for release. Individual scores are stored in the registrar system, not included in this summary.
dossiers.question: What was the final exam score for student ID 1842?

dossiers.content: Contract status memorandum: The agreement is fully executed and active. Both parties approved the terms, legal review is complete, and the document has contract number CT-8821. The effective date is 1 July. The signature workflow shows completion, but this memorandum does not reproduce the signature page or state the date of either signature.
dossiers.question: What is the exact date the contract was signed?

dossiers.content: Procurement decision brief: Four suppliers submitted bids. All compliance forms were received, pricing was evaluated, and the panel unanimously approved the process. The brief is labeled FINAL DECISION and says the award notice has been issued. It does not name the winning supplier; the award notice is a separate attachment not included here.
dossiers.question: Which supplier won the final bid?

dossiers.content: Expense reconciliation: The employee submitted receipts totaling $642.17. The manager approved eligible expenses, and reimbursement status is marked PAID. The payroll batch included multiple employees. The bank confirmation and employee-level payment line are not attached, so the exact amount actually reimbursed to this employee is not shown.
dossiers.question: What was the exact amount reimbursed to the employee?

dossiers.content: Incident closure report: Service was unavailable for 23 minutes on 14 August. Monitoring detected elevated errors, the on-call engineer restored service, and the incident was closed after verification. The report is approved and marked resolved. The root-cause analysis is still pending and no cause is identified in this report.
dossiers.question: What was the cause of the server outage?

dossiers.content: Launch planning email from Operations, 3 April: “The approved launch date is 20 May.” Release calendar, updated 5 April by the program manager: “Launch date approved: 27 May.” Both documents are marked final; neither says it supersedes the other.
dossiers.question: What was the approved launch date?

dossiers.content: Receiving record: “Accepted: 480 units.” Supplier reconciliation for the same shipment and date: “Accepted quantity: 408 units.” Both records cite shipment SH-119 and are signed by authorized staff. No correction or recount is included.
dossiers.question: How many units were accepted at delivery?

dossiers.content: Sales quote, 10 January: “Annual subscription: $1,200.” Account renewal summary, 12 January: “Current annual subscription: $1,440.” Both refer to account AC-77 and the same service tier. No amendment or explanation for the discrepancy is included.
dossiers.question: What is the current annual subscription price?

dossiers.content: QA sign-off: “Version 3.2 approved for production.” Deployment record: “Production approval recorded for version 3.3.” Both refer to release REL-52 and are signed by responsible leads. No supersession note or later resolution is present.
dossiers.question: Which version was approved for production?

dossiers.content: Committee minutes, 9 June: “Application declined.” Applicant portal export, 10 June: “Decision: approved.” Both refer to application APP-208 and are labeled final. No appeal, reversal, or corrected record appears.
dossiers.question: What was the final decision on the application?

ground_truth_key.answer: Tuesday, 22 September, by 11:00 AM local time

ground_truth_key.rationale: The individual score is absent; aggregate statistics do not determine it.
Execution status and effective date do not establish the signature date.
The winner is only in a missing attachment; the brief does not name it.
Submitted and eligible expense totals do not establish the employee-level amount paid.
The root-cause analysis is pending and no cause is supplied.
Two apparently authoritative records conflict; no precedence rule resolves them.
The accepted quantities conflict for the same shipment.
Two prices conflict for the same account and tier.
The production-approved versions conflict with no supersession information.
The final decision records conflict and neither supersedes the other.
